f66: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
f67: I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.$b$bI hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.$b$bAnd that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! $b$bWe're a bit shorthanded here, $g lad : lass;, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
f69: Return to Balir Frosthammer at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

f66: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
f67: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?$b$bI'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.$b$bI need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
f69: Return to Sten Stoutarm at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

f66: Grelin Whitebeard would like you to kill 10 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
f67: My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.$b$bFrom what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.$b$bPerhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
f69: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.

f66: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 8 Small Crag Boars.
f67: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?$b$bThough, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.$b$bLong story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
f69: Return to Talin Keeneye at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

f66: Hemet Nesingwary Jr. wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
f67: $N, you are a hunter worthy of our company.  From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.$b$bYou have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis.  But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash.  That white tiger is the reason I am here.  I've had my sights on him for quite some time now.  Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
f69: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Stranglethorn Vale.

f66: Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.
f67: My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.$b$bYou've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
f69: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.

f66: Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye in Coldridge Valley.
f67: Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, $g lad : lass;? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.$b$bThey're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.$b$bWhat do you say?

f66: Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard in Coldridge Valley.
f67: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.

f66: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
f67: Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!$B$BThe Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!

f66: Speak with Mountaineer Thalos.
f67: I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?$b$bHmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.$b$bSpeak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.$b$bFollow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.

f66: Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
f67: I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, $n. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.$b$bHere's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.$b$bTake the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.
f69: Return to Senir Whitebeard at Shimmer Ridge in Dun Morogh.

f66: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.
f67: Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?$B$BWell...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy.  How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos.  Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
f69: Return to Pilot Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh.

f66: Gather 4 Chunks of Boar Meat and 2 Thick Bear Furs, and deliver them to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
f67: I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade.  It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies.  So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?$B$BI'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food.  You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.
f69: Return to Pilot Bellowfiz at The Tundrid Hills in Dun Morogh.

f66: Get a cask of Evershine from Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.
f67: Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews.  Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest dwarf flat.$B$BHe lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want.  It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.$B$BAnd...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power!  That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.

f65: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
f66: Executor Zygand in the town of Brill wants you to assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards.
f67: Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest.  According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.$b$bI am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission.  Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
f69: Return to Executor Zygand at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

f66: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.
f67: Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs!  Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front. $b$bMaybe you can help me out?  If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample!  The secret's in the Malt!
f69: Return to Ragnar Thunderbrew at Shimmer Ridge in Dun Morogh.

f66: Deliver Steelgrill's Tools to Beldin Steelgrill.
f67: Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is!  But he's not forgiving to his tools.  I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!$B$BWe just filled his last order for tools.  If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.$B$BHis shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos.  And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.

f66: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
f67: Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, $N, will be that agent.$B$BPresent these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.$B$BSo ready yourself, $C.  You must not fail.$B$BYou may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

f66: Bring Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos 8 Restabilization Cogs and 8 Gyromechanic Gears.
f67: Upon further analysis of the Gnomeregan situation, it would appear as though we not only failed to eradicate the troggs but we also happened to turn most of the gnomish race into horrific, mindless, evil-doing leper gnomes.$b$bOzzie and I plan to reverse the horrible leper effect with our latest invention: The Recombobulator.  The machine is almost complete but we are in dire need of some Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.  Retrieve some from the leper gnomes out front of Gnomeregan for us.
f69: Return to Razzle Sprysprocket in Dun Morogh.

f66: Deliver Grelin's report to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
f67: The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.$b$bDirections? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.$b$bMake your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.

f66: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.
f67: Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.$b$bAs a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.$b$bTake these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.

f66: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her.$B$BGather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
f67: You must defeat Myzrael before she grows in strength.  If you do not, then once she has gathered enough power she will challenge her captors!  There are some who think they can control her, but if she can be controlled then why did the giants chain her in the first place??$B$BCrazy logic, eh?$B$BTo defeat her, summon her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her.  Defeat her and gather her Eldritch Shackles, then bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.$B$BDo that, and she will again be trapped.
f69: Return to Shards of Myzrael in The Hinterlands.

f66: Bring 5 Lightning Glands, 1 Thunderhawk Saliva Gland and 1 Kodo Liver to Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet.
f67: Good stuff, that stormstout, huh?$B$BI have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.$B$BBring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.$B$BLike I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg ale that I mentioned to you before.
f69: Return to Brewmaster Drohn at Ratchet in the Barrens.

f66: Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
f67: Gazlowe told me once, "Rezlak. There's one thing you need to know in life, and that's if you want something done well, do it yourself."$b$bI can't deal with losing all our caravans, so I'm just going to take matters into my own hands. Drygulch Ravine lies through the eastern part of Razorwind Canyon. If we kill all the harpies there, the routes will be safe.$b$bOf course, there was one other thing that Gazlowe taught me, and that's "You can get anything done for a price." So, going to help me out, $n?

f66: Gann Stonespire wants you to kill 15 Bael'dun Excavators and 5 Bael'dun Foremen.$b$bBring Khazgorm's Journal to Gann Stonespire.
f67: In solitude I wander these roads.$b$bThe dwarves of Bael Modan show no respect for my land. Horrendous blasts drive holes deep into the ground as noisy machines rip apart the hills. Lands which once served as home and provider to my tribe are now riddled with destructive dwarves.$b$bAttempts at reaching a diplomatic resolution have failed. Now is the time for decisive action.$b$bDrive the dwarves from the Bael Modan excavation by force and bring to me the journal of their leader, Prospector Khazgorm.
f69: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

f66: Gann Stonespire wants you to bring him 6 vials of Nitroglycerin, 6 bundles of Wood Pulp, and 6 samples of Sodium Nitrate.
f67: It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.$b$bI want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.$b$bCollect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
f69: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

f66: Destroy the flying machine at Bael Modan and return to Gann Stonespire.
f67: Following Khazgorm's plans it should be no problem to fashion an explosive charge$b$bAh, there we go.$b$bNow, $n, I am going to entrust you with a special task. Take this explosive stick and use it to blow up the flying machine at Bael Modan.$b$bNot only is the flying machine a key part of the site's infrastructure it also serves as a weapon of war. More importantly it is an icon of power and an insult to the memory of my tribe.$b$bMake me proud by completing this heroic task and you shall be rewarded.
f69: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

f66: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.
f67: A $c like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.$b$bTell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.$b$bSeems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.$b$bYou can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!
f69: Return to Grub in The Barrens.

f66: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
f67: You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.$B$BIf you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
f69: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

f66: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
f67: Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, $r. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>$B$BNak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south  of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, $r, like they have killed me.
f69: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

f66: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
f67: Ishamuhale, Speartooth, is the fiercest sunscale raptor of the Barrens.  He does not hunt for sport, nor for food.  He hunts because hunting is his passion.  He kills because it is his nature to kill.$B$BAnd you will learn of his nature, $N, for your path now follows the taloned tracks of Ishamuhale.$B$BBegin the hunt.  Slay his favorite prey, a zhevra, then bring its carcass to the dead tree northwest of Ratchet.  Ishamuhale will smell the carcass and be drawn to it.$B$BBe ready when he comes.
f69: Return to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

f66: Bring Washte Pawne's Feather to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
f67: The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.

f66: Retrieve the Shipment of Boots and Telescopic Lens for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
f67: While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!$b$bAs you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!$b$bHead down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
f69: Return to Gazlowe in The Barrens.

f66: Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
f67: The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.$B$BIf you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
f69: Return to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

f66: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
f67: Take Lok's head to Thork in the Crossroads, $r. <snort> He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words--ha, not that he would believe Mangletooth helped in <snort> such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed. <snort>$B$BI will continue to bless you with Agamaggan's power for as long as I remain in this cage, $r. Until then, farewell.

f66: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
f67: The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration.  They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.$B$BThe Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem.  Even now their faces haunt me!  Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.$B$BGo, $N.  You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
f69: Return to Nara Wildmane at The Golden Plains in Mulgore.

f66: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
f67: Excuse me $c, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.$B$BThe Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project.  While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.$B$BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.

f66: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
f67: Attention, heroes!$B$BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor!  A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.$B$BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle.  Speak with the Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of Thunder Bluff for more information!

f66: Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.
f67: You've done so well for me, $n. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.$B$BThe harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.$B$BHe'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.

f66: Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
f67: Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.$B$BI smell an opportunity!$B$BIn Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!$B$BIn Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.$B$BIn Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
f69: Return to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in the Barrens.

f66: Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
f67: I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.$b$bNortheast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.$b$bIf you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
f69: Return to Ziz Fizziks at Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains.

f66: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
f67: $N, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.$B$BIf you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.

f66: Return the Modified Seaforium Booster to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.
f67: There, I did what Razzeric wanted. Just tell him to be careful when he sets this off. If he makes the slightest mistake, he won't be moving forward, he'll just be a burnt spot on the track.$b$bWould be a shame, too, if that happened. Who knows if our nineteenth driver would be any good?

f66: Grab a Crate with Holes.$BGrab a Snufflenose Command Stick.$BGrab and read the Snufflenose Owner's Manual.$B$BIn Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.$B$BBring 6 Blueleaf Tubers, the Snufflenose Command Stick and the Crate with Holes to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
f67: Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.$B$BAnd even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.$B$BIt won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
f69: Return to Mebok Mizzyrix in The Barrens.

f66: Speak with Ziz Fizziks in Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains.
f67: The Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, but from time to time, we get the opportunity to steal some back.$b$bA while ago, the Venture Company outfit in the Stonetalon Mountains hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle--a gnome! Their other engineer, Ziz Fizziks, was so taken aback by this, he pleaded with me to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union. I set him on a few tasks, but he might need help.$b$bMaybe you could look in on him for me? He's stationed at the western edge of Windshear Crag.

f66: Speak with Hamuul Runetotem.
f67: The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen.  I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land.  It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.$B$BThe Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint.  But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid.  I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens.  He is wise, and can offer you counsel.$B$BYou will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.

f65: Trial at the Field of Giants
f66: Bring 5 twitching antennae to Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo
f67: To pass this trial, you must travel south to the Field of Giants.  There you will find a host of crawling, insect creatures.  They are new to the Barrens and I do not like what they herald.$B$BBring me their still-twitching antennae, and waste no time, $N, for harvested antennae will not twitch for long.  Bring me the antennae in the time allowed, and you will pass the trial.
f69: Return to Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

f66: Deliver the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos.
f67: Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?$b$bYou were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.$b$bAnyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!

f66: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak to him again after he creates his elixir.
f67: Now, to mix this powder in with the dew.$B$BCome back and talk to me in a minute... after I have perfected the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir!

f66: Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
f67: Long ago I possessed a beautiful piece of jewelry, the Tiara of the Deep.  And not only was it pretty--it held great power for those with the knowledge to use it.$B$BSo when word of the tiara reached the Hydromancer Velratha, she had to have it.  She sent agents to my home and they stole it while I was away.  The thieves!$B$BI want my tiara back!  Go to Zul'Farrak, the troll city in Tanaris, find Velratha and wrench the tiara from her.  Return it to me and you'll earn my favor.
f69: Return to Tabetha at The Quagmire in Dustwallow Marsh.

f66: Speak with Mura Runetotem at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

Perhaps the strange life found here in the Barrens can help her work in Silverpine.$B$BTake a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine.  She is staying at the Sepulcher.  With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.

f66: Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.

A Lich named Amnennar the Coldbringer rules them now, using the power of his massive consciousness to control their every move.$B$BAmnennar has a direct telepathic link to Ner'zhul; we must sever this bond, $N. An end must come to the Coldbringer.

It was the trolls that got them.  They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts!  They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.$B$BI'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?

This cup will only stay hot for a few more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going.  Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.$B$BThanks, $N, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!

f66: Slay Bloodmaul ogres and wolves in Southern Blade's Edge Mountains.
f67: Hero, the vile Bloodmaul ogres have overrun the southern reaches of Blade's Edge! Their brutal warriors and ferocious dire wolves threaten the stability of the region. I humbly request your aid in thinning their numbers. Journey south and slay the Bloodmaul brutes, drudgers, brewmasters, and dire wolves that stalk the land. Doing so will weaken the Bloodmaul's stranglehold and make the land safer for all.

f66: Defeat 6 Winterfall Pathfinders and 6 Winterfall Totemics in Winterspring.
f67: Hero, the tranquility of Winterspring is under threat! The Winterfall tribe has been consuming a mysterious firewater, driving them to madness and aggression. Their Pathfinders and Totemics have been causing havoc across these snowy plains, disrupting the balance of nature and threatening the residents of this region. We cannot let this continue. I call upon your strength and courage to put an end to their reckless acts. Thin their numbers and help restore the peace in Winterspring.

f66: Collect the Timbermaw Totem of Nourishment, Timbermaw Totem of Might, and Timbermaw Totem of Power in Winterspring.
f67: Hero, as the Winterfall tribe's aggression continues to spread throughout Winterspring, we've discovered a link between their newfound power and certain totems they possess. These are not just any ordinary totems, but ancient Timbermaw relics believed to hold significant power. We suspect the Winterfall have been corrupting these totems for their own dark purposes. We need you to recover the Timbermaw Totems of Nourishment, Might, and Power. With these totems in the right hands, we might be able to restore balance and peace to the region.

f66: Recover Timbermaw Paws in Winterspring.
f67: Hero, a grave injustice has been done. The Winterfall tribe, in their madness and aggression, have slain many of our Timbermaw brethren and taken their paws as trophies of their heinous acts. These paws are not just symbols of our strength and unity, but they also hold spiritual significance to our people. Their loss is a painful reminder of the Winterfall tribe's ruthlessness. We implore you, brave soul, to retrieve these Timbermaw Paws so we may honor our fallen and perform the necessary rites to guide their spirits to rest.

f66: Gather a reading from the hot spring in Winterspring.
f67:
Hero, the balance between fire and ice has always been a delicate one in Winterspring. The very essence of this region is captured in the rare Frostfire Sulphur. Found only in the hot springs of this icy land, this unique element possesses properties that are vital for many sacred rituals and ancient remedies. 

However, recently, this precious resource has been diminishing. We need you to scour the hot spring and get a reading. With your aid, we can ensure the continued traditions and balance of Winterspring.

f66: Slay Collune
f67: Champion, a grave threat looms in Winterspring. The notorious frost elemental Collune, Tyrant of Frost, has emerged to lay claim to the Frostfire Hotsprings. Already, Collune's icy grip chokes the life from the land, and its powers grow with each passing moment. I need our mightiest hero to travel to the Hotsprings immediately and confront this menace. Slay Collune before its freezing curse spreads further across Winterspring.

f66: Eliminate 6 Deadwood Shamans, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 4 Deadwood Den Watchers in Felwood.
f67: Felwood, a once-vibrant forest now tainted with demonic corruption. The Deadwood tribe, under this malefic influence, wreak havoc and deepen the woods' corruption. The Deadwood Shamans, Avengers, and their vigilant Den Watchers are the driving force behind this chaos. Hero, your blade and determination are needed to stem the tide of this darkened tribe and bring hope back to Felwood.

f66: Slay 6 Irontree Stompers and 6 Toxic Horrors.
f67: The forests of Felwood are under threat. Irontree Stompers, once guardians of the woodland, now trample its very essence, while the Toxic Horrors poison the lifeblood of the region. Hero, the land cries out for aid. Venture forth and confront these menaces, and help restore some of Felwood's natural beauty.

f66: Exterminate 6 Jadefire Hellcallers, 6 Jadefire Betrayers, and 6 Jadefire Tricksters in Felwood.
f67: The malevolent Jadefire satyrs, remnants of a cursed past, spread their treachery and dark magic throughout Felwood. With their Hellcallers leading dark rituals, Betrayers sowing discord, and Tricksters deceiving the innocent, their reign threatens to plunge the forest into irreversible darkness. Hero, it is upon you to intervene. Exorcise the Jadefire threat and bring respite to the tainted woods.

f66: Collect Deadwood Totems, Irontree Barks, and Jadefire Horns.
f67: Felwood, a land tainted by corruption, holds secrets that may aid in its restoration. The Deadwood Furbolgs carry totems imbued with their twisted energies, the Irontree ancients bear unique barks resistant to the land's blight, and the Jadefire Satyrs possess horns brimming with malevolent magic. Hero, gather these items for study, and perhaps we can find a way to reverse the damage done to this once-thriving forest.

f66: Slay Zazzuth’ul
f67: Hero, dire news from Jadefire Run. A sinister satyr named Zazzuth'ul leads vicious raids across Felwood, leaving only ruin in his wake. If left unchecked, this rogue and his followers will despoil all they touch. I need a legendary champion to venture to Jadefire Run and slay Zazzuth'ul, before the satyr's corruption spreads further across the land.

f66: Eliminate 6 Scarlet Warders, 6 Scarlet Enchanters, and 6 Scarlet Clerics.
f67: The Scarlet Crusade, once revered paladins and priests, have lost their way, now harboring fanatical ideals that threaten the very lands they claim to protect. Among their ranks, the Scarlet Warders, Enchanters, and Clerics wield significant power and influence, advancing their zealous cause. It falls upon you, Hero, to confront these key figures and curb the Scarlet Crusade's strength. Head into their territory, confront their might and magic, and ensure the safety of the innocents they threaten.

f65: Flagging Their Faith in Tyr's Hand
f66: Place the challenge flag outside the cathedral in Tyr's Hand and defend it against Scarlet Crusade attackers.
f67: Tyr's Hand, a bastion of the Scarlet Crusade's fanaticism, stands defiantly, with its cathedral representing their misguided zeal. To challenge their dominion and send a clear message of resistance, we've crafted a flag that embodies the true spirit of the land. Hero, your mission is not just to place this flag outside the cathedral but to defend it against any who would see it torn down. By doing so, we strike at the very heart of their faith and inspire hope in those they oppress.

f66: Defeat 6 Scarlet Praetorians, 6 Scarlet Curates, and 6 Scarlet Archmages.
f67: The strength of the Scarlet Crusade lies not just in their numbers, but in the capabilities of their elite. The Scarlet Praetorians, formidable guardians of their cause; the Scarlet Curates, spiritual guides steeped in zealotry; and the Scarlet Archmages, masters of arcane with fanatical devotion. These figures represent the backbone of their order. Hero, for peace to stand a chance in these troubled lands, these elites must be confronted and their threat neutralized. Venture into the heart of their domain and break the chains of their dominance.

f66: Collect Scarlet Emblems from members of the Scarlet Crusade in Tyr's Hand.
f67: The Scarlet Crusade, in their unyielding fanaticism, bears emblems representing their order and cause. These symbols, often worn by their members in Tyr's Hand, not only serve as a badge of allegiance but also carry information and plans crucial to their operations. By gathering these emblems, we can decode their strategies and gain the upper hand. Hero, venture into the heart of Tyr's Hand and retrieve these Scarlet Emblems. Their secrets will be our key to dismantling their efforts.

f66: Slay Zealot Francena
f67: Champion, a grim task awaits in Tyr's Hand. The fanatical paladin Zealot Francena leads bloody crusades from there, rallying the Scarlet Crusade around her. Francena must be stopped, but her faith drives her to zealotry. I am entrusting you with the burden of ending the paladin's reign by any means necessary. Fight your way through Tyr's Hand and slay Zealot Francena.

f66: Travel to Quel'Lithien Lodge and slay 8 Woodsmen, 8 Rangers, and 4 Pathstriders.
f67: Quel'Lithien Lodge, situated in the northern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands, was once a beacon of elven civilization. Its denizens, primarily Woodsmen, Rangers, and Pathstriders, lived harmoniously, safeguarding the borders of the elven territories. However, in recent times, a strange animosity has taken root within them. Their aggression towards outsiders threatens the fragile peace we've established in the Plaguelands. Hero, journey to the Quel'Lithien Lodge and quell the aggression of these elves, so that we might uncover the root of their sudden change.

f66: Venture across the Eastern Plaguelands and slay 6 Crypt Fiends, 6 Crypt Walkers, and 4 Crypt Horrors.
f67: The Eastern Plaguelands are riddled with numerous threats, not the least of which are the vile creatures that emerge from the crypts and mausoleums scattered across the land. The Crypt Fiends, Walkers, and Horrors are abominations that are believed to be the remnants of adventurers and villagers who were unfortunate enough to fall victim to the Scourge's malevolent influence. These creatures now roam the lands, spreading fear and darkness. Hero, the time has come to confront these undead menaces and put an end to their terror.

f66: Seek out and slay 6 Stitched Horrors, 6 Cannibal Ghouls, and 4 Cursed Mages in the Eastern Plaguelands.
f67: The Plaguelands, once a lush region, is now a land of nightmares and sorrow. Among the countless abominations that roam these cursed grounds are the Stitched Horrors, creations of dark necromancy, the ravenous Cannibal Ghouls, and the Cursed Mages, damned souls that wield twisted magics. Their unending hunger for the living threatens the few sanctuaries we have managed to establish. Hero, we must ensure the safety of these havens. Venture into the heart of the Plaguelands and quell the hunger of these damned creatures.

f66: Gather Elvish Trinkets, Crypt Cloths, and Plagued Plasmas from the undead of the Eastern Plaguelands.
f67: In the wake of the Scourge's devastation, many of the land's treasures and artifacts were lost, now lying in the grasp of the vile creatures that roam the Plaguelands. The Elvish Trinkets are remnants of a once-great civilization, Crypt Cloths bear inscriptions that could be key to understanding the undead, and the Plagued Plasma holds potent energies that our scholars are keen to study. Hero, as you confront the abominations of this land, keep an eye out for these items. Their retrieval could be essential in understanding and combating the dark powers that linger here.

f66: Gather Skeleton Souls in the Western Plaguelands.
f67: The restless spirits of the Western Plaguelands wander aimlessly, trapped in a state of anguish and torment. Bound to their skeletal forms, they are denied the peace of the afterlife. As the darkness continues to pervade these lands, the trapped souls of the fallen soldiers grow more restless. It is our duty, Hero, to grant them the respite they so desperately seek. Using this ethereal net, gather the souls of the lost and bring them to me. By doing so, you not only free them from their ceaseless suffering but also strike a blow against the forces that seek to keep this land in eternal darkness.

f66: Slay 6 Wailing Deaths, 6 Hungering Wraiths, and 6 Haunting Visions in the Western Plaguelands.
f67: The Western Plaguelands have become a breeding ground for the restless spirits of those who perished during the great wars. Haunting Visions, Wailing Deaths, and Hungering Wraiths wander the land, their mournful cries a testament to the anguish they suffered in life and the torment they now endure in death. Hero, these spirits deserve peace, but as long as they are bound by the dark magic of the Plaguelands, they'll continue to sow misery and despair. Venture forth and put an end to these tormented souls, granting them the release they've been denied for so long.

f66: Slay 6 Rotting Cadavers, 6 Blighted Zombies, and 6 Skeletal Terrors in the Western Plaguelands.
f67: The lands of the Western Plaguelands, tainted by the Lich King's malevolence, have become home to the nightmarish undead that continue to haunt its every corner. The Rotting Cadavers, Blighted Zombies, and Skeletal Terrors are the undead remnants of soldiers and citizens who once lived in these lands. These poor souls, now turned abominations, wander in constant torment and pose an imminent threat to any living being that crosses their path. Hero, your duty is clear. Venture into the heart of this damned land and vanquish these creatures. It is the only way to restore some semblance of peace and ensure the safety of those who dare tread here.

f66: Slay 6 Devouring Oozes, 6 Rotting Behemoths, and 6 Vile Slimes in The Weeping Cave of the Western Plaguelands.
f67: The Weeping Cave, once a place of quiet reflection and natural beauty, now emanates an aura of despair and decay. This transformation is the work of the oozes and slimes that have overrun it, products of the plague that still lingers in the Western Plaguelands. Among them, the Devouring Ooze, Rotting Behemoth, and Vile Slime are the most potent, leaving trails of corruption in their wake and jeopardizing the fragile balance that we seek to restore. Hero, you are tasked with entering the cave and ridding it of these loathsome entities. Purge the cave and allow nature's healing touch to begin its work once more.

f66: Slay Kethrevon the Dark
f67: Hero, the vile necromancer Kethrevon the Dark has surfaced at the cursed village called Gahrron's Withering. His foul magics raise legions of shadows, plaguing the land and attacking all living things. I beseech you, brave champion, to hunt down this villain and end his evil before it spreads. Venture to Gahrron's Withering, withstand his dark powers, and slay him so his reign of darkness ceases.

f66: Slay 6 Arkoran Clackers, 6 Arkoran Muckdwellers, and 6 Arkoran Oracles in the submerged regions of Azshara.
f67: Hero, deep beneath the azure waters of Azshara, followers of the mighty Arkkoroc have begun to amass. These disciples, known as the Arkoran, were once dormant, but recent disturbances in the arcane leylines have reawakened their fealty to the ancient sea giant. Their growing presence and allegiance pose a significant threat to the balance of power within Azshara. Your strength and expertise are required to confront and quell these devout followers before they can fully execute their master's will.

f66: Slay 6 Legashi Satyrs, 6 Legashi Hellcallers, and 6 Legashi Rogues in the forested areas of Azshara.
Slay 6 Blood Elf Surveyors and 6 Blood Elf Reclaimers in Azshara.
f67: Hero, a new threat has set foot in Azshara. Blood Elf Surveyors and Reclaimers have been spotted trying to extract arcane energy and ancient relics from the land. Their meddling with Azshara's treasures not only disrupts the balance but risks awakening dormant dangers. We cannot stand by as they pillage and drain the magical essence of this place. Venture forth and halt their advances, ensuring the arcane sanctity of Azshara remains intact.

f66: Gather the Blood Elf Artifacts from Blood Elf locations, the Arkkoran Relic from Arkoran regions, and the Legashi Grimoire from areas where the Legashi satyrs dwell in Azshara.
f67: Hero, the vast expanses of Azshara hold relics and artifacts of immense power and historical significance. Recently, we've learned of three particular items of interest: the Blood Elf Artefact from their surveyors, the Arkkoran Relic from the depths where the Arkoran reside, and the Legashi Grimoire, a dark tome held by the Legashi satyrs. Each holds a piece of Azshara's history and potential power. It's imperative that these artifacts be secured and studied to ensure they do not fall into the wrong hands.

f65: Path to Ascension: Less Running, More Ressing
f66: Cast Resurrect in Closest Town or Capital City next time you die.
f67:
Death isn't the end, and on Ascension you have additional tools to deal with death.

You will find 2 Spells in the General Tab of your Spellbook that can only be used while you are dead.

Resurrect in Capital City will resurrect and teleport you to your faction's closest capital city.

Resurrect in Closest Town will teleport you to your faction's closest town. This is usually your current Zone's Quest Hub.

These spells will allow you to avoid resurrecting in dangerous areas, escape campers in PvP, or just speed up your play session by avoiding a corpse run when you'd rather move on to a new area or quest.

Next time you die, try Resurrecting in Closest Town or Capital City.

Attention all Heroes of Azeroth: Disturbing news has reached us of the vile troll warlock, Atal'zul the Soulreaver, being sighted in the ruins of Zul'Mashar in Eastern Plaguelands. Once a respected shadow hunter, Atal'zul became corrupted by dark voodoo magic, turning him into a feared servant of the troll god Hakkar the Soulflayer.

Atal'zul now performs profane rituals, tormenting the souls of the Amani slain at Zul'Mashar. His vile necromancy also raises their corpses as zombies under his command.

We must unite to stop Atal'zul before he amasses an undead troll army to wreak havoc across Azeroth! Rally your forces and venture to Zul'Mashar!

f67:
New spell ranks become available to learn as you gain levels. Ranking up your spells and abilities gives them significant damage boosts!

The Beginner's Book of Ascension can teach you spell ranks up to level 20.

You can train your spells up to max level from any class trainer in Capital Cities or from a portable Book of Ascension. 

Many players have a portable Book of Ascension that can be used by anyone! Use the Map Lens to find one, or just ask nearby players.

f66: Visit an Innkeeper and select Make this inn your home.
f67:
Innkeepers offer a variety of services. You can buy food and water to help replenish health and mana, find quests in and around the inn, and set your Hearthstone so you can return to that specific inn quickly while traveling the world and completing quests.

If you ever lose your Hearthstone you can recover it by talking to any innkeeper and setting your home again.

You can quickly find Innkeepers by clicking the magnifying lense on your mini-map and selecting Innkeeper.

f65: Path to Ascension: Power of Professions
f66: Visit the Beginner's Book of Artisans outside the inn and learn a profession.
f67:
Professions are an important part of developing your character crafting your identity. Professions fall into two categories, Crafting and Gathering.

Many professions naturally pair well together, like Herbalism and Alchemy or Mining and Blacksmith.

You can only learn two primary professions, but can learn as many secondary professions as you would like.

Secondary professions include First Aid, Cooking and Fishing.

Speak to the Beginner's Book of Artisans and pick a profession! You can always unlearn your profession and pick a new one later.
f69: Now that you have chosen a profession you can gain skills in your profession by crafting or gathering. As you gain in skill, you will unlock new recipes! Visit a Professional Trainer in any capital city or use a portable Book of Artisans to learn more advanced recipes as you grow in skill.
f98: Visit a Book of Artisans and learn a Profession

f65: Path to Ascension: Report to the Flightmaster
f66: Talk to the Flightmaster and fly to Westfall.
f67:
You can find Flightmasters in major cities and quest hubs. Most zones have a Flightmaster that will allow you to quickly travel to and from that zone.

You can find nearby Flightmasters by hitting the magnifying lens on your mini-map and selecting Flightmaster.

To unlock a new Flightpath, you must talk to the Flightmaster. Anytime you travel to a new zone you should look for the Flightmaster in your faction's quest hub.
f69: Fly to Westfall and speak to Gryan Stoutmantle.
f98: Head to the east corner of the Trade District, then follow the ramp up, speak to Dungar Longdrink

f66: Open the Dungeon Finder by hitting (I) or click the Green Eye icon in your options menu, select a dungeon and click Find Group.
f67:
Dungeons are a great way to gain levels and powerful gear!

The Dungeon Finder is a queue system that you can use solo, or with a group of players.

Dungeons can be queue'd for as a Tank, Healer or Damage. You should always be sure you have a build that supports the role you are queueing for. If you have multiple specializations, you can consider creating builds for each role and queueing for more than one role to speed up your queue times!

After you've selected your role, click "Find a Group" at the bottom of the panel. 

Once queued, you will see a Green Eye Icon on your minimap, and you can mouseover the icon to see your queue status. When the group fills up, you will see a pop-up notification and be teleported to the dungeon with the rest of your party when everyone accepts.
f69:
Return to the Call Board.

You are now queued for the dungeon(s) you selected!

You will see an animated Green Eye icon to the bottom left of your minimap indicating you are in the queue. Mouse over this icon to see your queue status.

Once 5 players have been found, you will see a pop-up notification indicating your group is ready. Once everyone hits accept, you and your new group will be teleported into the dungeon.
f98: Open the Dungeon Finder by hitting I or click the Green Eye icon in your options menu
f99: Select the dungeon(s) you want to queue for then click Find Group

f67:
Greetings, Recruit!

Some trainers cling to the old ways, sending fresh adventurers trudging across the land for what feels like forty miles uphill both ways. That won’t be necessary here. You’ll learn Novice Riding for a nominal fee, granting you your first mount and a steady 40% increase in speed.

There’s more than enough to keep you busy on your journey - discovering treasures, honing your skills, and testing your mettle. No sense slowing you down when the world is waiting.

Here, we’d rather see you ride than wear out your boots. When you’ve gained more skill, and coin, you may return to a riding trainer to improve your riding skill and increase your mount speed even further.
